title: Pygame: A Primer on Game Programming in Python
description: Learn how Pygame lets you build games and rich multimedia programs in Python: draw to the screen, detect collisions, and handle input.
summary: When I started learning computer programming late in the last millennium, it was driven by my desire to write computer games. I tried to figure out how to write games in every language and on every platform I learned, including Python.
takeaways: You’ll receive a score upon completion to help you track your learning progress: Interactive Quiz Pygame: A Primer on Game Programming in Python Test your understanding of Pygame by working through questions on surfaces, the game loop, sprite groups, collision detection, and frame rate.
I tried to figure out how to write games in every language and on every platform I learned, including Python.
A basic understanding of object-oriented Python is helpful as well. pygame works with most versions of Python, but Python 3.13 is recommended and used throughout this article.
